title: Improvement: cda-main/src/mdd.rs use Results instead of Options for errors

## Description

A bunch of code paths in cda-main/src/mdd.rs use Options to actually indicate and error. 
This is unusual and not a good design. 
The goal of this issue is to rework this to proper Results instead.

## Motivation

Adhere to common rust practices.

## Proposed Solution

See above, use Results with an appropriate error.
